sources.title: AudioX-Turbo: A Unified Framework for Efficient Anything-to-Audio ...
sources.snippet: We benchmark AudioX-Turbo across a wide range of tasks, finding that our model achieves superior performance, especially on text-to-audio and text-to-music generation, while operating at only 4 sampling steps and requiring up to ∼ $∼$ 25 × $×$ fewer function evaluations (NFE) than multi-step baselines.
